name: Aldeanueva de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally into three bands from the upper fly to the lower hoist, blue at the upper hoist, white in the centre and red at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Aldeanueva de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: blue area at the upper hoist
red area at the lower fly
